name: gen_bio_field_observations_wetland_frogs
task: A field biologist dictates live wetland observations into a clean, formatted log entry.

turns.say: heading marsh transect field notes, okay so, date august twenty third, two thousand twenty six, start time six fifteen a m.
location, willow creek wetland, transect three, gps forty one point seven two nine north, eighty seven point nine one four west.
weather calm, overcast, temperature seventy two fahrenheit, no wait, make that seventy one, light drizzle after ten minutes.
new paragraph first observation, chorus frogs calling from cattails, estimated count about twelve, one juvenile seen near the boardwalk.
make that a list: water depth eight centimeters at stake a, eleven at stake b, p h six point eight, dissolved oxygen five point two.
scratch that, remove the dissolved oxygen value, the meter was uncalibrated.
note a painted turtle basking on log, carapace length about nine centimeters, behavior skittish when i approached within three meters.
add closing line, samples: two water vials, label wcw-t3-08-23, supplies cost twenty five dollars total.

judge.criteria: Final document should be cleanly formatted with a heading, date/time converted to figures, corrected temperature kept, list rendered with at least three items, and retracted/command phrases excluded.
